title: Appointment Setter - Instagram DMs (High-Ticket Fitness)
description: Read this before applying: this is a sales role. You will spend your day in conversations. This is not content editing, caption writing, video editing or general VA work. If that's what you're looking for, this isn't it. ABOUT THE ROLE Reshape Coaching helps South Asian professionals transform their bodies without giving up the food they grew up on. 15 years in the industry, 2,000+ client transformations, clients across the UK, UAE and US. We sell 16-week and 6-month transformation programmes at £1,495–£2,495, with an ongoing coaching option after that. We're looking for an experienced and driven appointment setter to qualify leads and book calls. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Work the Instagram inbox: reply to inbound DMs, qualify people, and book discovery calls into the founder's calendar - Proactively open conversations with new followers and people engaging with our content - Follow up with no-shows and conversations that went quiet - Log every conversation and outcome in our tracker, daily. TARGETS You'll work to set weekly targets for booked calls, show rate and response time. Targets are agreed with you in your first week and reviewed monthly. Hit them consistently and there are bonuses on top of your normal pay. You'll be measured on booked calls that show up, not on messages sent. HOURS 4pm–10pm UK time, Monday to Friday, plus two flexible hours each day for outreach, follow-ups and admin. Weekend overtime is optional. For Philippines applicants, the live window is 11pm–5am your time (midnight–6am from late October, when UK clocks change). This is a night shift and we're not going to pretend otherwise — it's reflected in what we pay. That window is when our core UK audience is off work and on their phones, which is when the conversations happen. It isn't flexible. Please only apply if you can genuinely hold these hours long term. PAY Monthly base salary, plus commission on every sale closed from the calls you book. Paid monthly via Wise. Pay is reviewed at 3 months based on performance. WHAT YOU NEED - Prior experience setting appointments in DMs for a high-ticket offer (£1,000+). We'll ask for the offer, the price point and your numbers. - Written English good enough that our leads can't tell it isn't the founder writing. - The discipline to log your data every single day without being chased - A reliable internet connection and a backup plan for outages - A genuine interest in doing this long term. We train properly, and we'd rather train once. ADDITIONAL SKILLS - Experience setting appointments specifically in health and fitness - Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Typeform, Calendly and spreadsheets - Experience selling to a western South Asian audience Training and career progression are both real here. Our setter playbook is written, tested and handed to you on day one. HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY - Do NOT apply through this website. Do NOT email. Apply the way you'd do the job. - DM us on ---------- - Your FIRST message must begin with the word 'SETTER' - Anything that doesn't gets deleted unread. - In that first message, include: - Your setting experience — the offer, the price point, and your monthly booked calls - Your rate expectations and your available hours in UK time - A link to your CV (Google Drive, Dropbox, anything — no attachments) - Then send a SECOND message. - A lead replies to one of our stories saying: "how much is your coaching?" - Send us your actual next message to them. Word for word, exactly as you would send it. One message. No preamble, no "here's what I'd say" — just send the message. - We reply to the ones who get it right within 48 hours. CLOSING DATE: 30th September 2026

title: Experienced Outbound Cold Email Specialist
description: We are looking for an experienced Outbound Cold Email Specialist to join our growing brand. The primary focus of this role is to identify relevant prospective clients and initiate high-quality, personalised conversations through cold email outreach. This is not a mass-emailing role. Every email must be researched, bespoke and relevant to the individual recipient or business. The successful candidate will understand how to use research, personalisation and strong written communication to generate genuine interest and qualified opportunities for our sales team. Key Responsibilities - Research and identify suitable prospective clients, including interior designers, architects, property developers, contractors, bathroom fitters, plumbers and other relevant trade and commercial customers. - Research each prospect and their business before making contact. - Write personalised cold emails tailored specifically to the recipient, their company and the type of projects they undertake. - Ensure emails feel individually written rather than generated from generic templates. - Clearly communicate why our products or services may be relevant to each prospect. - Manage structured follow-up sequences for prospects who do not initially respond. - Follow up previous conversations and potential leads generated through outbound activity. - Maintain accurate records of prospects contacted, follow-ups and outcomes. - Continually improve messaging based on response rates, engagement and the quality of opportunities generated. - Identify new customer segments and prospecting opportunities that could be relevant to the business. - Hand over interested prospects and positive responses to the sales team for further discussion and conversion. Experience Required Applicants must have: - A minimum of 2 years' proven experience in B2B cold email outreach or outbound email prospecting. - Demonstrable experience generating leads and conversations through cold outbound email. - Experience managing follow-ups and nurturing prospects who may require multiple points of contact before responding. - Strong written English and the ability to write concise, natural and professional emails. - Strong online research skills and the ability to identify meaningful information that can be used to personalise outreach. - Experience working with CRM, prospecting or email outreach platforms. - A good understanding of email deliverability and responsible outbound email practices. Experience targeting interior designers, architects, developers, construction companies, property professionals or trade customers would be particularly beneficial. What Success Looks Like We are NOT looking for someone whose primary objective is simply to send the highest possible number of emails. Success will be measured by the quality and relevance of outreach, positive response rates, qualified opportunities generated and the consistency of follow-up. The objective is simple: identify businesses that could genuinely benefit from working with us, approach them intelligently and personally, and create qualified conversations for our sales team. Once a prospect responds with genuine interest, our sales team will take responsibility for progressing and closing the opportunity.

title: Media Buyer for Amsterdam Real Estate (Meta + Google Ads)
job_title: Media Buyer for Amsterdam Real Estate (Meta + Google Ads)
description: We are ApartmentHub, a real estate agency in Amsterdam. We rent out and sell apartments in one of the most competitive housing markets in Europe, and we are expanding to Utrecht. We are hiring one media buyer to own paid acquisition end to end. This is not a "boost the post" job. We already have leadforms, a WhatsApp funnel, our own CRM and an engineering team. What we do not have is one person who owns the ad accounts and is judged on cost per real deal, not on cost per click. THE NUMBERS, SO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE WALKING INTO We start at roughly 3.000 euro a month in ad spend, and it grows the moment you show it works. We are telling you this up front on purpose. If you are only comfortable at six figures a month, this is not your role. At our level you do not get to run twelve ad sets and let the algorithm sort it out. You get a few, you keep them out of the learning phase, and you make a modest budget produce real deals. Here is why that is still a great deal for you: our average closed deal is worth a few thousand euro to us. One extra deal a month already pays for the entire media budget. Get us three and you will have built yourself a much bigger budget to play with. Few media buyers get to see that link between their campaign and the invoice this directly. WHAT YOU WILL RUN - Meta lead campaigns for tenants, in Dutch and in English, feeding our own hosted leadforms - Click to WhatsApp campaigns. Almost every lead we get ends up in a WhatsApp conversation, so this channel matters more to us than a classic landing page - Meta and LinkedIn campaigns aimed at landlords and property owners. This is our highest value audience and it is almost untouched - Google Ads search on rental and selling intent, plus remarketing, and Performance Max only where it earns its place - A geo campaign for our Utrecht launch, on top of Amsterdam - TikTok and Instagram Reels ads built on our own video output - Retargeting across every audience we already own Selling and buying services are a channel we are opening, not one we are optimising. If you like being the first person to make a new revenue line work, that part is yours. MEASUREMENT IS HALF THE ROLE A lead is cheap. A signed deal is not. We want someone who closes the loop. - Meta Pixel plus Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4, server side tagging where it is worth it - Offline conversion imports so the ad platforms learn from actual deals in our CRM, not from form fills - Realistic optimisation targets. At our budget you will not get the weekly event volume for value based bidding on closed deals, and we know it. We expect you to pick the highest quality event that still gets enough volume, and to use deal data for reporting, lookalikes and creative decisions - Consent and privacy done properly. We operate in the EU, so GDPR is not optional - Weekly numbers we can act on: spend, cost per lead, lead to appointment, appointment to deal, cost per deal, per channel and per audience WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO - Own the strategy, build, structure and daily optimisation of every ad account - Set and defend budgets. Move money to what works and switch off what does not, fast - Run a disciplined creative testing programme: hooks, angles, formats, audiences. At our budget that means testing inside a small number of ad sets and in sequence, not fifteen ad sets fighting each other for the same 100 euro a day - Brief our AI video creator and our UGC creators, and tell them exactly which angle to produce next based on what the data says - Write ad copy in English yourself. Dutch copy is translated and checked by our team, but you drive the message - Build landing page and leadform variants and test them, including qualification questions that filter out people we cannot help - Keep an eye on the funnel after the click: WhatsApp reply rates, appointment rates and drop off points - Deliver a weekly report and a monthly plan. Short, honest, with a recommendation WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT: YOU GET ENGINEERS We have an in house tech team and our own CRM built on Supabase. If you can describe what you need, we build it. Examples of what we can build for you: - Conversions API and offline conversion pipelines straight from our CRM, so deal value flows back into Meta and Google automatically - Automatic UTM tagging and lead source attribution all the way to the invoice - Live dashboards on our own data, so you are not stuck exporting spreadsheets - New leadform variants and landing pages built to your spec within days - Automated alerts on spend anomalies, rejected ads and broken tracking Your job is to buy media well. Our job is to make sure you never lose a day to plumbing. YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU HAVE - At least 3 years of hands on media buying, with Meta Ads as your deepest platform. This is a hard requirement - Real experience advertising to a European audience, in a previous job, not as a side project. This is a hard requirement and we will ask you which countries and for which company. Europe is not the US with different currency: consent banners change what you can measure, GDPR limits what you may store, the CPMs behave differently, and copy that shouts the way American ads do gets ignored here. We do not want to teach you that from scratch - The Dutch market is what we would really like to find. If you have run campaigns in the Netherlands, understood how Dutch people react to advertising, or worked with a Dutch company before, say so early in your application, because it moves you to the top of the list - Real Google Ads experience across search and remarketing. If Google is not your strongest platform, say so honestly and tell us what you have run - Managed budgets yourself, with full account access, not as a junior clicking inside someone else's structure. Size matters less to us than ownership. Someone who made 3.000 euro a month work beats someone who spent 100.000 without ever feeling the cost - Proven lead generation work. High ticket, considered purchases are a big plus. E commerce only is a weaker fit for us - Comfort with tracking: Pixel, Conversions API, GTM, GA4, UTM discipline - The instinct to question a good looking number. Cheap leads that never convert are a failure, not a win - Good written and spoken English, and the confidence to disagree with the founder when the data says so - Reliable internet, your own machine, and at least 4 hours per day overlap with Amsterdam time NICE TO HAVE - Real estate, property or relocation marketing - LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads - Experience with WhatsApp as a conversion channel, click to WhatsApp campaigns or a business messaging platform - Comfort with n8n, Make or simple API work - Basic understanding of SEO and how paid and organic feed each other WHAT WE OFFER - A competitive salary that matches your level, paid on time, every time. We agree the number together once we have seen your work - Full time, long term. We are building a team, not filling a gig - Two audiences with very different economics, two cities, two languages, so the work does not get boring - Real ownership of the ad accounts and the budget, with a direct line to the founder and no agency layers - An engineering team that removes your busywork - Full access from day one: your own seat on the ad accounts, the analytics, the CRM data and the dashboards. Nothing is kept behind the founder. One detail we are open about: our Meta ad account sits under a partner business manager, so you get a user seat there rather than ownership. Everything else is ours and yours to run - Every tool you need is paid for by us, ad spend included. You never spend your own money HOW TO APPLY (READ THIS CAREFULLY, WE FILTER ON IT) Applications that skip these steps get deleted without reading. 1. Use this exact subject line: MEDIA BUYER - your first name - years of Meta Ads experience 2. Start your message with the word ZUIDAS so we know you read the whole post 3. Tell us the highest monthly ad spend you have personally managed, on which platform, and for what kind of business 4. Which European countries have you run ads in, for which company, and over what period? Name one thing about advertising in Europe that surprised you compared to other markets. If you have worked on the Dutch market, tell us here 5. Send one case study: the situation, what you changed, and the numbers before and after. Screenshots of Ads Manager are welcome, blur the client name if you have to 6. Answer in 3 sentences: a campaign brings in cheap leads but almost none of them turn into customers. What do you check first, second and third? 7. Answer in 2 sentences: how would you feed the value of a closed deal back into Meta and Google, and why does that change how the campaign performs? 8. Which do you know better, Meta or Google, and how big is the gap? An honest answer scores better here than a claim that you are equally strong at both 9. What is your monthly rate expectation in PHP, and are you available full time? Bonus that moves you straight to the top of the pile: look at our public channels, find one paid campaign angle we are clearly missing, and describe it in five sentences. Audience, hook, format, offer, landing point. We reply to every applicant who follows the steps above.

description: Job overview: Type: Part-time, 22–24 hours a week, growing with us Pay: $7–9/hour depending on experience — 22–24 hours a week, roughly $665–855 a month Hours: 8:00am–12:00pm Pacific, Monday to Friday. Skills: Healthcare admin, excellent spoken and written English, careful and warm Please read this part first: I've posted a couple of roles recently and I'm replacing both of them with this one. I'd been looking for two people — someone to coordinate care, and someone separate to support our members week to week. Having talked to a lot of candidates, it's clear this should be one job. The person who books the appointments, sends the lab kits, and knows who hasn't collected theirs is the same person who should be reading our members' journals. Nobody coming to it cold could write anything useful. So this is one role, more hours, and a better job than either of the two it replaces. I'm also being much stricter about who I'm asking to apply, because I had far more applications than I could work through last time — most from people with no healthcare background. Please only apply if all three of these are true: You have medical or healthcare experience — nursing, medical technology, pharmacy, healthcare administration, medical VA work, or similar You can send a short video introduction, described at the bottom The night shift genuinely works for your life, long-term If any of those is a no, please don't apply. I'll only be reading applications that include the video and the writing sample, and I'd rather not waste your time. A strong plus: experience or study in nutrition, wellness, or functional health. If you applied to either of my earlier posts: this one replaces them both and I'm not working from those applications any more. If you meet the requirements above, please apply again here and follow all the steps at the bottom. I'll read it properly this time. About us: Hi — I'm Dr. Diane Angela Fong, a naturopathic doctor in California. I run Cleanbody, a practice and education program for people with severe eczema and other chronic diseases. Most of the people who find us have been struggling for years. They've tried steroids, elimination diets, and a dozen creams that didn't work. By the time they reach us they're exhausted and they've mostly stopped believing anything will help. We run lab testing to find what's actually driving their skin, then a twelve-week program to fix it. The program works — but only if people stay with it. And the hardest week isn't the first. It's week six, when their skin flares, they're discouraged, and nobody notices they've quietly stopped. This role has two halves. Most of the week you keep the practice running. On Mondays, you're the person who notices. Your week: Monday — 6 to 8 hours. You start earlier and work through to noon Pacific. Messages pile up over the weekend, so you clear those first, then move on to the journals. If you don't finish them, they carry into Tuesday — better done properly than done fast. Tuesday to Friday — 4 hours, 8:00am to 12:00pm Pacific. Coordination, callbacks, and any journals left over. In Manila time that's 11:00pm–3:00am from March to November, and midnight–4:00am from November to March. The two halves: Responsibility #1: Patient Care Coordination — every day You keep everything moving so I can focus on patients. Returning calls. We don't get many and most go to voicemail — your job is to call people back during the morning window. Appointment questions, kit questions, rescheduling. Scheduling and rescheduling Sending lab kits and tracking whether they've been collected and posted Chasing the people who haven't collected. This is the single most common reason someone's care stalls, and preventing it is worth more than almost anything else you'll do. Entering results into the chart when they arrive Documenting supplement refills Producing superbills on request Issuing and revoking member discount codes Answering routine questions by email — never clinical ones Responsibility #2: Accountability coaching — Mondays Our members keep a journal each week: how they slept, what they ate, whether they took their supplements, how their skin feels. They submit by Sunday night. Every Monday you read all of them and write back to each person. You tell them what they're doing well. You ask what's getting in the way. You remind them that week six is hard for almost everybody and that they're not behind. Then you send me a short report: anything I need to know, who's gone quiet, who's stalled, the three questions that came up most, and one win worth reading out. I use that report to plan the live call I run mid-week, so what you send me shapes what our members hear. I'll need that report by the end of your Tuesday shift. Why this is one job and not two: you already know this member's results came back last week, that they've reordered twice, and that they cancelled a visit in October. Someone reading their journal cold couldn't write anything specific. You can. The line you never cross: You are not giving medical advice. Not on the phone, not in writing, not in either half of this role. You never comment on symptoms, interpret a lab result, suggest a supplement, or answer a question about someone's protocol. That's my job and I'm the only one who can do it. I'll train you thoroughly on exactly where the line sits and give you approved wording for everything that comes up. Safe: "You've logged six hours' sleep for two weeks — what's getting in the way?" Not safe: "Your flare might be the eggs." or "Maybe try half the dose." You comment on what the person did, never on what their body is doing. This is harder on a call than in writing, because someone will ask you directly and you'll want to help. You'll have a scripted answer ready for exactly that. Anything urgent reaches me automatically through our system, so you are never responsible for catching an emergency. Your job is noticing patterns, not crises — that's a relief, not a restriction. What you need: Required: A medical or health background. Nursing, medical technology, pharmacy, nutrition, physical therapy, healthcare administration, or medical VA work. This is not negotiable — you'll be handling lab kits, results, and refill documentation, and you need to already understand what you're looking at. Clear spoken English. You'll be calling patients in the US, and they need to understand you easily the first time. Excellent written English — warm and natural, not stiff or formal Genuinely careful. In this work, small errors matter. Comfortable following a script and escalating rather than improvising A headset and a quiet room for calls. Not a laptop microphone, not a shared space. Reliable internet, and Mondays genuinely free — that's the day the week depends on Able to commit long-term. This role grows as we grow. Nice to have: Personal or family experience with eczema, or another chronic skin condition. This matters more than anything else on this list. If you've lived with it, or watched someone you love live with it, you already understand something I can't teach. Experience with an EHR or patient portal Nutrition, wellness, or functional health — study or work experience. You'll be surrounded by this material and it helps enormously to already speak the language. Social media or video editing. I publish a lot — YouTube, reels, a podcast — and if you can edit or schedule content, there's more work here for you and it's how this role grows fastest. Not required: Any US credential Availability outside the morning window Weekend or evening work — there is none What it's like to work here: We're small. We will be a two person team supporting our patients. I'm direct about what I need, I don't micromanage, and I would far rather you ask than guess. I'm expecting a baby in March 2027 and I'll be on leave from March to June. During those four months you'll be the main point of contact our members have. That's exactly why I want to hire and train someone properly now rather than scrambling in February — and it's why I'm looking for someone who wants a long-term role rather than a stopgap. There's a bonus in July 2027 for being here continuously through that period. I'd rather say that up front than hope. My website is www.cleanbody.health if you want more information about my practice before you complete these items. Send me: 1. A short note about your background and why this kind of work appeals to you. Not your CV. 2. This writing sample. Here is a member's journal entry from their sixth week: "Honestly this week was rough. My skin flared up worse than it's been in a month and I don't know why. I've been doing everything — I haven't had dairy in five weeks, I'm taking all the supplements, I'm sleeping better than I was. And it still got worse. I'm starting to wonder if this is worth it. I skipped my journal a few days because I didn't want to write it down." Write your reply. Around 100–150 words. Remember: you're not a doctor. I want to hear how you speak about people — and since you'll be calling patients, I need to hear you speak. If you or someone close to you has lived with eczema, tell me about that. title: Content Assistant + Short-Form Video Editor
description: Part-Time, Ongoing | Remote // About the Role // I run House of Agalliao, a growing hair and beauty brand focused on custom wig making and wig education. You do not need to know everything about my brand or industry on day one. I’m looking for someone who is observant, creative, reliable and willing to learn. // Who I’m Looking For // You may be a great fit if you’re very online and naturally aware of what’s happening across Instagram, TikTok and internet culture in general. You understand current content trends, conversations, memes, sounds, editing styles and emerging formats — but you also understand that following every trend doesn’t automatically make good content. You should be a strong short-form video editor with a good eye for pacing, storytelling, text placement, music, sound effects, transitions and visual details. You should be comfortable editing Instagram Reels, TikToks and other vertical short-form content and be able to do basic photo editing or simple graphics when needed. I’m especially interested in someone who can see potential in raw footage that may not immediately look exciting. You should also be able to study another person’s personality and gradually understand their voice, sense of humor, preferences and audience. Good content should do more than look pretty. It should hold attention, communicate something and ultimately support the business. I want someone proactive enough to say: “I saw this trend and think we could adapt it this way.” Or: “You mentioned this while filming — I think that could actually be its own Reel.” Or: “For next week, I need you to record these three clips and I can turn them into these content ideas.” You should be organized, reliable with deadlines, consistent with communication, comfortable receiving feedback and capable of working independently once you have proper direction. I don’t expect you to know everything. I do expect you to be resourceful enough to research, experiment and figure things out. // What You’ll Help With // Your responsibilities may include: * Editing Instagram Reels, TikToks and other short-form videos; reviewing raw footage and identifying the strongest moments; developing pacing and storytelling within edits; adding appropriate on-screen text, subtitles, sound effects, music, screenshots, graphics, B-roll or visual elements; cleaning up audio; finding appropriate sounds or music; repurposing existing or older content; finding opportunities to turn one recording into multiple pieces of content; researching trends, creators, hooks and content formats; bringing new content concepts to me; organizing raw footage and completed content; helping maintain a content calendar; creating simple shot lists or recording requests for me; tracking content that needs to be recorded, edited, revised or published; helping prepare content for posting; and helping me build a more consistent content creation process. My current goal is approximately 3–5 quality pieces of content per week. I care much more about creating content that feels intentional, engaging and on-brand than posting filler just to say we posted something. // My Editing Style + Creative Direction // I don’t currently have one rigid or fully established editing style. Most of the content I create myself is relatively simple — clean cuts, occasional on-screen text or captions, music, sound effects and small visual details. But I would like my content to become more visually engaging, creative and recognizable over time. Part of why I’m hiring for this role is because I want someone who can help me develop that style with me. I already have a strong sense of what I like and, equally important, what I don’t like. I want someone with enough creative instinct to take those preferences, study my personality and brand, experiment with different approaches, and gradually help establish an editing style that feels distinctly like House of Agalliao and me. Eventually, I would love for there to be certain visual elements, editing choices or creative touches that people begin to recognize as part of my content — without making every video look exactly the same. I am not looking for someone who simply adds captions, random effects and transitions to every video and considers it finished. I like content that feels: Clean. Current. Personality-driven. Engaging. Intentional. Sometimes the strongest edit may be very simple. Other times a video might benefit from humor, sound effects, screenshots, B-roll, text, visual references, interesting cuts or other creative elements that strengthen the story. I want someone with enough creative judgment to understand the difference. I also don’t want an editor who applies the exact same editing template or style to every client. I want someone willing to experiment, learn what works for my audience, take feedback and help us develop our own visual identity over time. // Brand Voice // You’ll be working with content that represents both me personally and House of Agalliao, so understanding my personality will be important. My content tends to be conversational, confident, relatable, educational and sometimes funny. I don’t want my content to feel overly corporate, robotic, cheesy or obviously written by a social media assistant. You are not expected to understand my voice perfectly on day one. What matters more is whether you are observant enough to learn it. I want someone who pays attention to the way I naturally speak, the phrases I use, what I find funny, how I explain things and how I communicate with my audience — and gradually becomes better at helping me create content that still sounds and feels like me. Beauty + Hair Industry Understanding Previous experience in the hair industry is a plus, but it is not required. However, you must be interested and willing to learn. My content involves wig making, wig education, beauty entrepreneurship and the behind-the-scenes process of running and growing a beauty brand. You will encounter terminology surrounding things like closures, bundles, knots, glueless wigs, wig construction and other aspects of the hair industry. I don’t need someone pretending to already know everything. I would rather have someone curious enough to ask questions, learn the terminology and understand the audience than someone treating the content like generic beauty content. // Content Assistance // Editing is the primary part of this role, but I’m also looking for someone who can help make content creation feel less overwhelming for me. There may be weeks when I have a lot of footage ready to edit and weeks when I have less. During lighter editing periods, your work may shift toward researching content ideas, reviewing older footage for repurposing opportunities, organizing content, identifying trends or references, planning upcoming concepts, creating shot lists and helping determine what I should record next. title: Per Project Wordpress Builder
description: We are hiring a **per-project WordPress + Elementor website builder** to work with our website production team. This position is ideal for someone who wants consistent project work, clear systems, and the ability to earn more as they prove they can handle projects independently. We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to drag Elementor widgets onto a page. We want someone who **thinks.** You should be able to follow instructions, pay attention to details, troubleshoot problems, communicate well, and use tools like ChatGPT and Claude intelligently. ### What We Provide Our production process is highly systemized. For standard website builds, **the website content will already be provided and mapped into the build.** You are not being paid these project rates to research and write an entire website from scratch. Your primary responsibility is taking the assets, content, instructions, and systems we provide and turning them into a polished finished website. ### What You'll Do Projects may include: * WordPress website builds * Elementor Pro * Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile implementation * Following approved designs or templates * Implementing mapped website content * Forms * Images and image optimization * Internal linking * Basic on-page SEO implementation * Rank Math * ACF/dynamic content when required * CSS adjustments * Website QC * Revisions * Troubleshooting issues * Following our build SOPs and documentation requirements We will train you on our specific production system. ### Compensation This is a **per-project position**, not a monthly salary. #### Probation Period During your initial probation/training period: **$90 per completed standard website** There is no bonus structure during probation. The purpose of this period is to learn our process, understand our expectations, and demonstrate that you can consistently complete projects correctly. Once you have proven yourself, you can advance into our normal production tiers. #### Tier 1 — Production Builder Standard 10-page website: **$70 base** Plus: * $10 First-Pass QC Bonus * $5 On-Time Completion Bonus * $5 Clean Handoff / Documentation Bonus **Up to $90 per standard 10-page website** #### Additional Pages Pages beyond the standard project are compensated based on complexity: **Basic / cloned page:** $3 per page **Enhanced page:** $4 per page Advanced custom pages, functionality, or unusual project requirements are priced separately before work begins. #### Tier 2 — Certified Builder **$100 per standard 10-page website** Tier 2 is earned through performance. Typically, we want to see at least 5 successful builds demonstrating: * Strong first-pass QC * Reliable on-time delivery * Good communication * No recurring quality issues * Understanding of our SOPs * Ability to troubleshoot independently #### Tier 3 — Advanced Builder Typically: **$125–$175+ per project** These builders can handle more complex projects, troubleshoot independently, require less management, and consistently produce high-quality work. Your earning potential increases as your value and capabilities increase. ### Who We're Looking For Experience matters, but **how you work matters more.** We would rather hire someone with 4 years of experience who is adaptable, hungry, and pays attention than someone with 10 years of experience who is stuck in their ways. You should: * Have solid Elementor Pro experience * Understand WordPress * Be comfortable using ChatGPT and/or Claude * Follow instructions carefully * Ask questions when something is genuinely unclear * Be capable of working independently * Communicate well with a team * Notice mistakes before QC notices them * Be willing to learn our processes * Accept constructive feedback * Take deadlines seriously * Think critically * Troubleshoot problems * Look for solutions instead of immediately saying something cannot be done We don't expect you to know our internal AI systems before joining. If you already understand how to effectively use ChatGPT or Claude, we can teach you our specific workflows. ### The Mentality We're Looking For When you encounter a problem, we don't want your first response to be: **"What do I do?"** We want you to first think: **"What is supposed to happen here? What information do I have? What can I test? Can I solve this safely myself? If I can't, what information does the team need from me to help solve it?"** There is nothing wrong with asking questions. In fact, asking good questions is extremely important. But there is a major difference between asking a thoughtful question after investigating a problem and requiring someone to think through every problem for you. ### How to Apply Please complete everything below. **Start your application with:** **"I READ THE ENTIRE POST."** Then answer: **1. Portfolio** Send 3 Elementor websites you personally worked on. Tell us specifically what YOU did on each website. **2. Experience** How long have you been working with WordPress and Elementor? What parts of a website build can you confidently complete independently? **3. AI** How do you currently use ChatGPT or Claude while building websites? Give us a real example. **4. Problem-Solving Scenario** Imagine you are assigned a website. The content has already been written and mapped. You are halfway through the build and notice three things: 1. One section does not fit the content very well. 2. The mobile version looks significantly worse than the desktop version. 3. A form is not submitting properly. The project manager will not be available for the next two hours. **Explain exactly what you would do.** Walk us through your thought process in order. Tell us: * What you investigate * What you try yourself * What you would change without approval * What you would NOT change without approval * What work you would continue completing * When you would escalate something * What you would send the project manager when asking for help There isn't one perfect answer. We want to see how you think. ### Growth We want builders who become more valuable over time. Someone who starts by following our SOPs but eventually becomes capable of independently troubleshooting difficult builds is worth considerably more to us. If you're competent, reliable, efficient, willing to learn, and interested in getting better instead of simply getting projects done, this could become a very strong long-term opportunity.

title: Outbound Caller & Lead Generation Specialist
description: READ THIS FIRST: The shift is 8:00 PM to 3:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. That is 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM in Florida. This is a permanent night schedule. Our phone and SMS platform, currently being upgraded. You will help us make it work. CRM, email marketing tools, Google Sheets, and AI writing tools You need to be genuinely comfortable with software. Not an engineer, but the kind of person who opens a new tool and figures it out without a manual, and who spots a better way to do something and says so. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR *Clear, confident spoken English. This is the most important requirement. You will be on the phone with American business owners, shop managers and municipal fleet staff every day, under our name. Neutral accent, easy to understand, comfortable holding a conversation that is not on a script. *Strong written English. Your texts and emails go straight to customers. Clear and natural, not stiff and not robotic. *Real outbound experience. You have called strangers and existing customers for a living and you are not nervous about it. *Background we especially want: dealership service BDC, appointment setting, outbound sales or SDR work on a US account, service scheduling, customer retention or reactivation, US collections, or contact center work with an outbound component. *Tech savvy. NOT A FIT IF You cannot commit to a permanent night schedule You are looking for general admin or virtual assistant work You are uncomfortable on the phone, or you only want to do chat and email You measure your work in calls made rather than results You want a narrow job description that never changes HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED On one thing: vehicles that come through our bay doors because you got them there. Not calls made, not messages sent, not appointments booked. Vehicles that arrive and get worked on. We will show you the number every week, and we pay you on it. COMPENSATION USD $4.50 to $5.50 per hour depending on experience. Performance commissions for vehicles that arrive because of your outreach begin after a 90-day trial period. Paid twice a month in USD via Wise, PayPal, or direct deposit. This is a long-term role, not a project. The right person grows with the shop, and we treat long-term contributors well. TO APPLY, INCLUDE 1.) A 2-minute voice or video recording in English. Tell us about a customer or prospect you got to say yes after they had already said no. What did you actually do? 2.) A short note on your last phone-heavy role and what number you were measured on. Give us the real figure. 3.) A writing sample. A description of your internet setup and your backup plan for power and connection. 6.) The word AIRBRAKE somewhere in your application. Applications without the voice recording and the writing sample will not be reviewed.
